_provenance: Derived from a 14-team round-robin volleyball tournament structure with 4 courts per round. 14 rounds total (one per team as anchor). Each round has 4 courts; each court plays one match between 2 teams (4 courts x 2 teams = 8 teams active, 6 idle per round). Teams are identified only by their structural position (avatar ID 0-13) per DEC-9. rowCount=14 because N=14 — the permutation maps position i to round rowSequence[i], optimizing the order in which rounds are played for maximum team variety.
_note: n=14 is the number of rounds (rows) being permuted. avatarCount=14 because each of the 14 teams is an avatar. Each row represents one round of play; 8 avatars are active per round (4 matches, 2 teams each). The permutation assigns round-order to time slots. PACKET_SIZE=17_000_000 covers approximately 5 seconds at the H-2 target of 300 ns/perm.
